newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-MALDINI TO STAY AT MILAN UNTIL 2001.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MALDINI TO STAY AT MILAN UNTIL 2001.

text.p: Italy captain Paolo Maldini extended his contract with league champions AC Milan by one year to 2001 on Monday.
"As you can see, I intend to go a long way," the defender said. "When the contract expires I'll be 33 and then we will see what happens.
"Of course I'm influenced by the example of Baresi and if I have accepted to stay for the next five years it means I haven't ruled out possibly emulating Franco."
Milan captain Franco Baresi, now 36, notched up his 500th league game for Milan last season and is still playing for the club, which he joined in 1977.
Maldini joined Milan in 1984 and, like Baresi, has remained there.
